description: Speech-driven IVR with a reprompt and echo-back, then hold, then a technician.

segments.label: ivr_menu
segments.text: Welcome to Example Wireless. In a few words, tell me what you're calling about. You can say things like pay my bill or technical support.

segments.label: ivr_menu
segments.text: Sorry, I didn't get that. You can say pay my bill, technical support, or something else.

segments.label: ivr_menu
segments.text: Okay, technical support. Is that right?

segments.label: hold
segments.text: Got it. One moment while I connect you.

segments.label: hold
segments.text: All of our technicians are currently helping other customers. Your estimated wait time is 6 minutes.

segments.label: human
segments.text: Hi, you've got Priya in tech support, who am I speaking with?
